gates.details: Boundary, source-structure, architecture, all workspace typechecks/tests and production builds passed; the application suite covered 317 files and 1706 tests.

All six selection families, add/subtract/intersect, feather, off-canvas input, raster/mask brush, erase, fill, gradient, undo and retention passed. Animated ants submitted 2 overlay frames with 0 correction frames and 0 executions for every heavy render stage. Brush and mask gestures produced one undo entry with 1,048,576 and 131,072 dirty-tile bytes respectively. Stable-tail deltas were 0 DOM nodes, 0 listeners, 0 GPU bytes and 84,396 heap bytes.
45 layers and 4 raster masks survived PSD export/reopen with equal semantic signatures and no page errors.

notes: Brush and eraser now honor Lock Transparent Pixels through dedicated premultiplied-alpha GPU blend pipelines.
Raster masks and preserved Photoshop vector masks are independently queryable and survive native persistence.
The EHS-396 corpus exposed and fixed a separate export gate for current derived text previews; its subsequent export correctly stopped at the unrelated smart-object compatibility guard.
EHS-402 was selected as the mask roundtrip oracle because it has raster masks without unsupported smart objects.
